maker.service_redesign: Auction a fixed allocated inventory quota at specified price/term, or pay real availability retainer with separately enforceable breach terms. Neither promises unlimited useful public depth.
maker.inventory_identity: A CEX hedge/positive cash equity does not restore native delivery inventory. Replenishment needs an actual asset route and transfer time.
maker.demand: No issuer retainer mandate, maker quote or verified third-party customer identity obtained.

rivals.cost: Wallet/range/composition security qualification not delivered in this WO

rivals.independent_fragment_assembly: Do not conflate order semantics with unrestricted OTX

execution.benchmark_rule: No speed/fee superiority without equivalent rights, same native workload and lifecycle. Public spot-book arithmetic is not an executable native liquidity route.

preserved_six_launch_attacks.scope: Read-only rerun of preserved six-class exact model; no frozen file rewritten or native checkpoint recounted

result.scope: Exact stateful synthetic counterexamples; reconstructed mechanisms, not old file identity or a validated launchpad

selective_admission.limitation: Uniform price does not force solver inclusion.

sequential_auction.limitation: Order determines execution price even in a solvent reserve-backed pool.

creator_roundtrip.limitation: Reserve conservation is not fair price discovery; cross-batch extraction remains possible.

split_search.limitation: Equal per-address allocation rewards additional identities without Sybil resistance.

revocable_liquidity.limitation: LP withdrawal authorization defeats lasting post-launch depth.

reserve_backed_alternative.predicate: reserve >= floor * outstanding claims; operator withdrawals must preserve it
reserve_backed_alternative.observations: Solvency is distinct from fairness, fee coverage, market depth and demand. Transferable claims need authentic mint/burn and native proof.
reserve_backed_alternative.minimal_counterexample: One reserve unit withdrawn without burning a claim violates full floor backing.

combinations.launch_plus_execution: Secondary sale is a right, not a bidder. Launch-only cash retention/escrow can remain rational without a new DEX.
combinations.risk_plus_trading: Transferable beneficiaries remain UNRESOLVED; fixed-recipient risk and independent RFQ/OTX research do not depend on this blocked security validation.
combinations.finite_inventory_plus_issuer_finance: A retainer consumes issuer finance. It cannot be simultaneously counted as free project proceeds or protected buyer reserve.
combinations.shared_event: Share observation identity/code costs only; no funded principal saving. An oracle-free refund mechanism need not inherit oracle dependency.
combinations.new_independent_alternative: Senior treasury finance plus junior residual, priced as existing debt/equity rather than automatically marketing it as insurance. Fixed-recipient variant can be researched without transferable-record assumptions.
